bylaw.title: Squamish-Lillooet Regional District Electoral Area D Firearms Bylaw

definitions.meaning: same meaning as in the Firearms Act (British Columbia)
definitions.quote: shall have the same meaning as in the Firearms Act (British Columbia) Chapter 145 R.S.B.C and Amendments.

definitions.meaning: same meaning as in the Firearms Act (British Columbia)
definitions.quote: Permit” shall have the same meaning as in the Firearms Act (British Columbia) Chapter 145 R.S.B.C and Amendments.

prohibitions.where: within the limits of the areas defined in Schedules A and B
prohibitions.quote: discharge a firearm within the limits of the areas defined in Schedules A, and B attached to and forming part of this bylaw

prohibitions.what: discharge a firearm on or across a highway or near listed places
prohibitions.where: on or across a highway, or within 100 meters of any school building, school yard, public park, playground, church, cemetery, workshop, place of business, dwelling house, or other place where persons may be assembled or engage in work of any kind
prohibitions.quote: without limiting the foregoing, discharge a firearm on or across a highway or within 100 meters of any school building, school yard, public park, playground, church, cemetery, workshop, place of business, dwelling house, or other place where persons may be assembled or engage in work of any kind.

exceptions.quote: Section 3 of this bylaw does not apply to a person: (a) who is: (i) a peace officer

exceptions.permit: permit issued by the Chief Provincial Firearms Officer for an indoor shooting range
exceptions.quote: who is authorized by a permit issued by the Chief Provincial Firearms Officer to discharge a firearm in an indoor shooting range under the Firearms Act (British Columbia)

exceptions.permit: shooting range approved in writing by the Chief Provincial Firearms Officer
exceptions.quote: who is on a shooting range approved in writing by the Chief Provincial Firearms Officer.
who is a bonafide farmer or their agent acting on behalf of the farmer in rural zoned properties when engaged in a farm operation

exceptions.permit: Regional Board resolution with RCMP and Chief Provincial Firearms Officer permission
exceptions.quote: The Regional Board may by resolution, on receipt of a written application from an approved club or organization, grant permission to the applicant for the operation of a rifle range or trap club, or both, within a closed area

distance_rules.from_what: any school building, school yard, public park, playground, church, cemetery, workshop, place of business, dwelling house, or other place where persons may be assembled or engage in work of any kind
distance_rules.quote: within 100 meters of any school building, school yard, public park, playground, church, cemetery, workshop, place of business, dwelling house, or other place where persons may be assembled or engage in work of any kind
